subject: FinOpt evaluation: milestone slate, owners & decision criteria
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finopt.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 15:10:00 -0500
Subject: FinOpt evaluation: milestone slate, owners & decision criteria

Hi Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a proposed milestone slate so we can lock dates:

Summary of goals (as discussed)
- Proof the inference economics on your typical job types (chat summarization, reranking for search).
- Maintain quality within current thresholds (no >2% top-line regression on NLU intent accuracy).
- Demonstrate predictable latency at scale (p95 target discussed below).

Proposed milestone slate (3-week compact trial)
1) Kickoff & environment prep (Week 0) — confirm dataset access + SOC2 excerpt and IP terms (owner: Neha) — target Nov 30
2) Ingest & baseline run (Week 1) — Redwood runs baseline on a 10k sample and shares metrics (owner: Jonas) — target Dec 6
3) Optimization pass (Week 2) — batching/quant profiles + cost tradeoffs; quick A/B on model variants (owner: Jonas + Marissa) — target Dec 13
4) Final readout & decision (Week 3) — scorecard, recommended configuration, next-step commercial proposal (owner: Neha) — target Dec 20

Decision criteria (please confirm):
- Quality: end-to-end intent/slot accuracy delta <= 2% compared to current system
- Latency: inference p95 <= 300 ms for your medium-size payloads
- Cost: per-1k-token cost improvement >= 20% vs current baseline (TBD)

Request from you before kickoff:
- Confirmation of the success criteria above or explicit edits
- Dataset access (S3 or secure link) and a schema/sample (we referenced finopt-sample-schema.csv below)
- A short list of stakeholders for the readout (ops, DS, procurement)

Attachments: FinOpt-MAP-v1.xlsx (mutual action plan), SOC2-excerpt.pdf

If that looks good I’ll schedule the kickoff for the week of Nov 30 and create a shared runbook + calendar invites.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

---
Note: MAP contains tentative meeting owners & blocks.
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finopt.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carmen Lopez <carmen.lopez@finopt.com>, FinOpt Data Science <ds@finopt.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2026 16:28:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FinOpt evaluation: milestone slate, owners & decision criteria

Neha — thanks for the clear recap. High level: we’re aligned. A few clarifications/requests: 

1) Success criteria edits
- Quality: agree on <=2% regression but we’ll validate on the set we provide (intent+entities).
- Latency: can we either make p95 <= 300ms or show the tradeoff curve at 95/99th percentiles? p99 matters for user-facing flows.
- Cost: 20% is a good aspirational target — we’ll need the baseline cost calc from you after you run the initial 10k sample.

2) Stakeholders for readout: Carmen (Head of Product), Rajesh (Ops — rajesh@finopt.com), and myself. I’ll confirm procurement contact next.

3) Data access: attached a sample schema and a small synthetic payload file (finopt-sample-schema.csv). We will share an S3 read-only path prior to kickoff.

4) Compliance: SOC2 excerpt is fine — please share any additional data-retention options Redwood supports (esp. short-term KV cache TTLs).

Kickoff week of Nov 30 works for us. If you want to start with a dry run for infra on Nov 30 and do the baseline Dec 1 that’s also ok.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Rivera
Director, ML Platforms | FinOpt Analytics
alex.rivera@finopt.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finopt.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FinOpt evaluation: milestone slate, owners & decision criteria

Thanks Alex — looping in a more structured cadence and owners from our side. Added a few operational checkpoints and a lightweight evaluation rubric below.

POC cadence (detailed)
- Tue Nov 30 (Kickoff, 30–45m): infra handshake, S3 access, test credentials, quick runbook walkthrough (Owner: Neha)
- Wed Dec 1 (Dry-run ingest, small smoke): infra verification, sample inference run, sanity metrics (Owner: Jonas)
- Week of Dec 6 (Baseline runs + config capture): run full 10k sample, capture p50/p95/p99, per-model token cost (Owner: Jonas)
- Week of Dec 13 (Optimization & A/B): 2x config runs (batching and quant), cost/latency tradeoff deck (Owner: Jonas + Marissa)
- Mon Dec 20 (Readout, 60m): scorecard + recommendation + next commercial steps (Owner: Neha)

Weekly check-ins: Thu 30m sync starting Dec 3 at 10:30am ET (optional for core DS members; required for ops/procurement on readout week).

Evaluation rubric (quick)
- Pass: Meets all three decision criteria OR shows a clear migration path with measurable gains in cost or latency and no >2% quality regression.
- Conditional: Achieves two criteria and provides a mitigation plan for the third (e.g., latency improvement with a minor quant tradeoff).
- Fail: Cannot meet latency & cost targets and no feasible tuning path.

Attachments: I updated the MAP with calendar placeholders and a proposed weekly agenda (see FinOpt-MAP-v1.xlsx).

Jonas — can you confirm the infra checklist below and whether we need any specific IAM roles for the S3 share?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@finopt.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2026 10:15:00 -0500
Subject: Re: FinOpt evaluation: milestone slate, owners & decision criteria

Quick infra checklist & notes: 
- Access: please provide an S3 read-only ARN or a pre-signed URL (we prefer read-only role with temporary creds).
- Dataset: one consolidated CSV/ndjson + a schema file (we got finopt-sample-schema.csv — good).
- VPC/connectivity: if you want model traffic to stay in your VPC, send the peering details; otherwise our secure egress is fine for the trial.
- Secrets/keys: confirm whether you prefer us to pull test API keys or you’ll run inference calls from your side pointing to our endpoint.
- IAM: minimal role to list/read the bucket + KMS decrypt if objects are encrypted.

Proposed technical kickoff plan (Nov 30)
- 10:00–10:15: Intro + owner intros
- 10:15–10:35: S3 access + runbook walkthrough (we’ll validate sample file)
- 10:35–10:45: Smoke run & logs verification
- 10:45–11:00: Next steps & calendar invites

I’ll attach a short runbook stub after this that lists the exact CLI commands we’ll run.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: FinOpt evaluation: milestone slate, owners & decision criteria

All good from our side — Nov 30 kickoff confirmed at 10:00am ET. I’ve asked Rajesh to join the kickoff for ops context and Carmen will join for product-level questions.

We’ll drop an S3 read-only ARN into the shared drive by EOD Nov 29 and share the procurement contact separately. Looking forward to the smoke run.

Thanks,
Alex
